production.note: US model years. Start: 2006 was the Z06's first model year; GM's January 2005 release said "Production of the 2006 Corvette Z06 will begin in the second half of 2005" (source gm-2006-z06-reveal-release), so the first cars were built in calendar 2005. End: GM's January 2012 release calls 2013 "the final year for the current 'C6' generation" (source gm-2013-427-release), and Corvette Action Center's final 2013 model year production listing, credited to GM Bowling Green Assembly, includes the Z06 (source cac-2013-production).

body.note: Fixed-roof coupe only. GM: "2-door hatchback coupe with fixed roof; rear-drive (Z06)".

displacementL.note: 7,008 cc (GM Media 2007 table: "Displacement (cu in / cc): 427.6 / 7008", source gm-2007-corvette-specs); GM's January 2005 reveal table printed 7,011.3 cc (source gm-2006-z06-reveal-release). Either rounds to 7.0. Marketed as "7.0-liter/427-cubic-inch".

transmission.note: Tremec six-speed manual only; no automatic was offered on the Z06. GM's 2012 release confirms the LS7 cars were still manual-only for 2013 (source gm-2013-427-release).

powerHp.note: SAE certified (J2723). Quote: "With 505 horsepower (377 kw) and 470 lb.-ft. of torque (637 Nm), it also is the most powerful passenger car engine ever produced by Chevrolet and GM." Spec line: "505 horsepower (377 kw)* @6300 rpm", footnote "Horsepower and torque SAE certified." GM's January 2005 reveal release gave a preliminary 500 hp at 6,200 rpm (see discrepancies). The GM Media table for 2007 repeats "505 / 377 @ 6300*" (source gm-2007-corvette-specs).

weightLb.note: Manufacturer curb weight, standard Z06 (fixed-roof coupe, six-speed manual, the only configuration). Quote, GM Media specification table for the 2007 model year, Z06 column: "Curb weight (lb / kg): 3132 / 1421". GM's releases for the 2006 model year gave only an estimate, "Curb weight of 3,130 pounds / 1,420 kg (estimated)" (source gm-2006-corvette-release), so the first non-estimated GM figure is used. The Auto Channel's August 2006 review of the 2006 Z06 gives the same number for the 2006 car: "3132 pounds claimed" and "Curb weight: 3132 lbs." (source autochannel-z06-2006). The reference model year is 2007 to match this table; the power rating is the same for every model year.

discrepancies.reason: Preliminary vs final rating: the January 2005 reveal release quoted 500 hp at 6,200 rpm before the car was in production; the August 2005 release for the 2006 model year gives the SAE-certified 505 hp at 6,300 rpm.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 505 hp, the certified rating the car was sold with, repeated in GM's 2007 specification table.

discrepancies.reason: Estimate vs final figure: GM's 2006 model year releases label 3,130 lb "(estimated)"; GM's specification table for the 2007 model year gives 3,132 lb with no such label.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,132 lb, the non-estimated manufacturer figure, which The Auto Channel also reports as the claimed curb weight of the 2006 car.
